note: The candidate controls the Variant encoding byte, selecting an array whose element type is UA_TYPES_DATAVALUE.
The controlled array length and element bytes are decoded into the Variant data array.
The precheck uses a memSize/32 lower bound that does not reliably enforce that the remaining encoded input is sufficient and consistent for every decoded DataValue element.
Each DataValue element is decoded from the controlled stream into the allocated Variant array.
When the decoded Variant is cleared, its DataValue array is recursively destroyed.
Clearing a DataValue reached from the decoded array dereferences the nested Variant state, which is the target heap-use-after-free read site in the reported crash stack.
